magicdonut.config.title: MagicDonutUtils Config
magicdonut.config.payconfirm.tooltip: Protects you from sending big payments by accident.
magicdonut.config.payconfirm.enabled.des: Ask for confirmation before large /pay commands.
magicdonut.config.payconfirm.threshold.d: Payments of at least this amount must be confirmed.
magicdonut.config.payconfirm.timeout.des: How long a pending payment stays confirmable.
magicdonut.config.auction.tooltip: Run your own auctions: hold an item, the highest payment wins.
magicdonut.config.auction.help: Hold an item and use /auction start [seconds] [minBid]. Bids are payments to you; the highest one wins. Nothing is paid or refunded automatically.
magicdonut.config.auction.enabled.desc: Show the floating item panel while an auction runs.
magicdonut.config.auction.duration.desc: Used when /auction start has no duration.
magicdonut.config.auction.minbid.desc: Payments below this amount are ignored.
magicdonut.config.gamble.help: Coinflip, dice and slots with a virtual balance. Nothing here touches the server or your real money. Open it with /gamble.
magicdonut.config.gamble.starting.desc: Balance you get after pressing Reset balance.
magicdonut.config.profit.tooltip: Track how much money you made today.
magicdonut.config.profit.help: Shows your balance and today's profit above the hotbar. Needs an API key or a stats proxy. /dailybalance start sets today's starting point.
magicdonut.config.profit.enabled.desc: Also toggleable with a keybind (unbound by default).
magicdonut.config.profit.refresh.desc: Every refresh is one stats request for your own account.
magicdonut.config.dev.tooltip: API settings. Only needed for overhead stats.
magicdonut.config.dev.status.proxy: Using a stats proxy: you are verified with your Minecraft account, no API key needed.
magicdonut.config.dev.status.ok: API key set: overhead stats are available.
magicdonut.config.dev.status.missing: No API key: overhead stats are off. Everything else works without one.
magicdonut.config.dev.help: DonutSMP API keys are limited to ranked players or approved projects.
magicdonut.config.dev.apikey.desc: Your personal DonutSMP API key. Never share it.
magicdonut.config.dev.baseurl.desc: Only change this to point at a proxy you trust.
magicdonut.gamble.title: Gamble Simulator
